Brief
A single photograph sits in the middle of a dark field, cut into twelve
rectangular pieces that lie a little apart from one another, each one turned by
a degree or two so the seams catch the eye. Clicking a piece lifts it and snaps
it back into its place in the picture, and the seam it closes disappears; the
canvas does nothing at all between clicks, so the only movement a viewer ever
sees is the movement they caused. The photograph fills about two thirds of the
shorter side and the field around it stays almost black.

Assertions
no_motion
responds(click)
loads(image)
